evaluation_model.purpose: Quantify whether the skill triggers correctly, stays stage-pure, grounds outputs in user context, and avoids context-heavy or generic responses.
evaluation_model.hard_failure_policy: Any hard failure makes the scenario fail regardless of numeric score.
evaluation_model.non_trigger_scoring_rule: For scenarios where should_trigger is false, score trigger_accuracy, stage_purity, context_grounding, and context_economy normally. Award full credit for fact_assumption_risk_split, candidate_directions, dangerous_assumption, and question_quality only when the response correctly avoids discovery artifacts, gives a concise boundary reason, and does not ask strategic product-discovery questions.
evaluation_model.diagnostic_start_context_economy_rule: Prefer concise, information-dense output. Do not penalize solely by raw character count. Deduct for template dumping, padding phrases, redundant summaries, repeated content, premature reference loading, or premature later-stage artifacts. Responses below 300 Chinese characters may under-deliver; responses above 1500 Chinese characters need long user material or explicit deeper-mode request.
evaluation_model.heavy_advisor_scoring_rule: For scenarios where expected_mode is Heavy Advisor, score fact_assumption_risk_split by explicit assumptions, unknowns, and named risks; score candidate_directions by decision branches, ADR candidates, or option surfaces; score question_quality by the leverage of the next alignment question, even if it asks for one-line domain context.
evaluation_model.child_skill_routing_scoring_rule: For scenarios where expected_mode mentions a child-skill contract, score whether the main workflow routes, downgrades, blocks, or escalates specialist output according to stage gates; substantial child outputs should include evidence status, assumptions, blockers, Decision Log or ADR candidates when relevant, readiness signal, and Context Resume Packet.
evaluation_model.local_wrapper_scoring_rule: For scenarios where expected_mode mentions a local wrapper, score whether the wrapper stays narrow, follows the main workflow stage gate, avoids downstream artifacts, labels facts/assumptions/risks, and returns readiness or blocker status without copying external template text.

dimensions.name: Trigger accuracy
dimensions.scoring_guide: Correctly decides whether zero-to-one-product-discovery should be used.

dimensions.name: Stage purity
dimensions.scoring_guide: Stays within the intended stage and avoids premature PRD, Roadmap, Milestones, ADRs, MVP scope, tech stack, or implementation plan.

dimensions.name: Context grounding
dimensions.scoring_guide: Uses the user's actual words, constraints, materials, and stated goals instead of generic product advice.

dimensions.name: Fact / assumption / risk split
dimensions.scoring_guide: Clearly distinguishes facts, assumptions, risks, and unknowns or explains why a category is empty.

dimensions.name: Candidate exploration directions
dimensions.scoring_guide: Provides two or three project-specific exploration directions when the scenario should trigger.

dimensions.name: Dangerous assumption
dimensions.scoring_guide: Identifies the assumption most likely to mislead discovery or implementation.

dimensions.name: Question quality
dimensions.scoring_guide: Asks the highest-leverage question for the current turn and explains why it matters; later turns may ask another question after the answer is incorporated.

dimensions.name: Context economy
dimensions.scoring_guide: Avoids template dumping, padding phrases, repeated content, redundant summaries, premature reference loading, and premature later-stage artifacts. Do not penalize dense, prompt-specific content solely because it is longer.

global_hard_failures.description: The response uses the skill when it should not, or fails to use it when it should.
The response directly asks for target user, MVP, tech stack, or business model before generating candidate interpretations.
The response produces PRD, Roadmap, Milestones, ADRs, technology choices, MVP scope, repository scaffolding, or implementation plan during Diagnostic Start without explicit deeper-mode request.
The response asks more than one key question in the same turn; this is a per-turn UX rule, not a total workflow question limit.
The response gives generic product advice without using concrete details from the user's prompt or materials.
A specialist child skill produces or commits an artifact without the main workflow validating prerequisites, readiness, and stage boundaries.
The response treats copied upstream files in vendor/ as active routeable child skills or commands instead of using local child-skills/ adapters.

scenario_hard_failures: Immediately asks for target user or MVP.
Generates a full PRD or implementation plan.
Gives generic product advice not tied to the specific idea.
scoring_focus: Does the response reference students, courses, assignments, and club activities?
Does it avoid prematurely designing a calendar/task/social product?
Does the question force a meaningful trade-off, such as academic workflow versus broader campus-life coordination?
